lines.en: My soles crush the flagstones.

lines.zh: 四格高的身板横过营地
lines.en: Four blocks tall, I cross the camp.
I grind the ground with each step.
My thick legs land and raise dust.
I turn sideways to squeeze through stone.
My shadow reaches the wall first.
I drag my steps closer.
The ground shudders at every step.
I circle half around you.
One bend of the knee clears the ditch.
I adjust my footing slowly.
My huge foot flattens the grass.
I stand, chest rising and falling.
I clench my fists until they creak.
I look down at you, saying nothing.
I let out a heavy breath.
My shoulders lift a little.
I roll my thick neck.
My toes scrape the dirt.
I stare into the distance.
My arms hang like two pillars.
I tap the ground once.
The wind passes over my skin.
I shift my weight to the left.
I crane my thick neck skyward.
I wait in silence.
I look down at you.
You look small from up here.
Your eyes cannot dodge as fast as your body.
I tilt my head and study you.
You are standing too close.
My breath washes over your face.
I lift a foot and set it back.
I bring my face nearer.
I wait for your first move.
I say nothing, only watch.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看见了
lines.en: I saw what you are holding.
I narrow my eyes slowly.
My shadow swallows you.

lines.zh: 铜皮底下的气，压得发闷。
lines.en: The ki under my brazen hide hums low and heavy.
I extend a foot to test you.
I tilt my head the other way.

lines.zh: 四格高的影子，先记住你了。
lines.en: A four-block shadow remembers you first.
You step back; I step forward.
That one hurt.
I give half a step and steady.
A new gash opens on my hide.
I force out a sound.
I cannot quite close my fist.
I shake my heavy head.
Blood runs down my arm.
I brace a knee and breathe.
That one had some weight.
I grit my teeth and hold.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西是什么
lines.en: What little thing is in your hand?
I catch a sweet smell.
Is that thing edible?
I lean down to sniff it.
I reach out to grab it.
My nose twitches.
I follow the smell.
Hold it higher, I cannot see.

lines.zh: 肚子不争气地响了一声
lines.en: My stomach growls once.
I open my mouth and wait.
You hit me like a wall.
I sink a foot and hold.
I nudge you aside with a foot.
You slide past my leg.
My hide bounces you off.

lines.zh: 撞得我自己也退了半步
lines.en: The impact sets me back half a step.
You step on my instep.
I twist and make a gap.
I look down to see where you hit.
We crash like two stone walls.
She takes her place beside me.
We stand as one wall.
I glance down at her.
She is far shorter than I.
We nod to each other.
I give her half a step of room.
We tread the ground together.
Her steps are lighter than mine.
I lower my arm a little.
We hold this place together.
I stoop and pick up rubble.
I pinch up the bead on the ground.
I close it in my palm.
I pick up a broken beam.
I crush it without thinking.
I pick up fallen armour.
Two fingers are enough to pinch you up.
I tuck it into my waist cloth.
I search for that thing again.
This little thing won't even fill a gap in my teeth.
I raise my head and lock on.
I settle both shoulders into stance.
My lead foot plants hard.
I will not drag this out.

lines.zh: 这股气，能让我踢个痛快。
lines.en: This ki will make for a fine round of kicks.
My knees start coiling.
I turn my flank toward you.
You are just close enough to kick.
I lick my cracked lips.
I press one step forward.

lines.zh: 那点小动作别以为我没看见
lines.en: Do not think I missed that move.
I raise one leg slowly.
You had better plant your feet.
I will cut off your retreat first.
My shadow tightens around you.
There is no avoiding this.
I raise my leg and hold it.
I wait for an opening.
He backs off; my steps follow.
I grind my right foot in place.
I measure the reach of my kick.
When he closes, I draw the leg back.
I deliberately show half my body.
If he hangs back, I am patient.
I sink my weight low.
My instep tightens.
He circles; I pivot with him.
I watch where his feet land.
When his arm lifts, my foot goes first.
I keep a second strike in reserve.

lines.zh: 他跳开的高度我算到了
lines.en: I have measured how high he jumps.
I keep my breathing steady.
His gap is at his right hip.
I wait half a breath more.
My leg sweeps across.
My knee drives into his chest.
I snap the leg back after impact.
The second kick comes tight behind.

lines.zh: 他架住一脚，第二脚到了
lines.en: He stops one kick; the next lands.
I stomp after him, striking.
My instep cracks his cheek.
I kick three times without pause.

lines.zh: 一记下劈把他砸进土里
lines.en: A downward heel drives him into dirt.

lines.zh: 他闪开，我踢断一根柱子
lines.en: He dodges; I shatter a pillar.
I lift a knee to knock his blade wide.
My arm sweeps him off his feet.
I pin his shoulder and press down.

lines.zh: 这一脚带着全身的分量
lines.en: That kick carries all my weight.
He flies out and breaks the wall.
I recover; the ground has caved in.

lines.zh: 我从石柱的影子里迈出
lines.en: I step out from the pillar's shadow.
The bricks crack under me first.
My four-block frame fills the doorway.
I was placed here for a reason.
I straighten up inch by inch.
The air grows heavy.
I glance around once.
My arrival is a wall.
I let my fists hang at my sides.
Two deep prints mark the ground.
Everyone here takes half a step back.
I am in no hurry; I plant myself.
Stone dust falls from above.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，屋子一震
lines.en: I inhale and the room shakes.
Someone has called me out.
I look at you and go still.
I have business here.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你脚边铺开
lines.en: My shadow spreads past your feet.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的皮，疼得发烫
lines.en: Fire sears my hide hot.
I slam down from above.
Water floods my throat.
The blast shoves me back.
Something sticks in my shoulder.
Magic works into my bones.
Hunger makes my legs weak.
Lightning strikes and I lock up.
The ground under me is gone.
